tools.name: statuspageme_list_status_pages
tools.description: List the status pages in the account, with their names, slugs and settings. Good first call to find a status_page_id. API: GET /user/api/v1/status-pages.

tools.name: statuspageme_get_status_page
tools.description: Get one status page by id, with its settings and linked monitors. API: GET /user/api/v1/status-pages/{id}.

tools.name: statuspageme_list_incidents
tools.description: List incidents, newest first, optionally for one status page or changed after a time. Use it to review recent or ongoing outages. API: GET /user/api/v1/incidents.

tools.name: statuspageme_get_incident
tools.description: Get one incident by id, with its status and timeline. API: GET /user/api/v1/incidents/{id}.

tools.name: statuspageme_list_maintenances
tools.description: List scheduled and past maintenance windows, optionally for one status page or created after a time. API: GET /user/api/v1/maintenances.

tools.name: statuspageme_get_maintenance
tools.description: Get one maintenance window by id. API: GET /user/api/v1/maintenances/{id}.

tools.name: statuspageme_list_monitors
tools.description: List the uptime monitors in the account (site, API and DNS checks) with their current state. API: GET /user/api/v1/monitors.

tools.name: statuspageme_get_monitor
tools.description: Get one monitor by id, with its check settings and current state. API: GET /user/api/v1/monitors/{id}.

tools.name: statuspageme_get_monitor_availability
tools.description: Get the availability figures (uptime and related metrics) of one monitor for a period. API: GET /user/api/v1/monitors/{id}/availability.

tools.name: statuspageme_list_metrics
tools.description: List the live metrics shown on one status page. API: GET /user/api/v1/metrics?status_page_id=.

tools.name: statuspageme_create_incident
tools.description: Create a new incident on a status page. It appears on the public page at once. With notify_subscribers true, subscribers receive a message. API: POST /user/api/v1/incidents.

tools.name: statuspageme_add_incident_update
tools.description: Add a timeline update to an incident, optionally with a new incident state. It appears on the public page at once. API: POST /user/api/v1/incidents/{id}/updates.

tools.name: statuspageme_create_maintenance
tools.description: Schedule a maintenance window on a status page, with start and end times. With notify_subscribers true, subscribers receive a message. API: POST /user/api/v1/maintenances.

tools.name: statuspageme_update_maintenance
tools.description: Change the title, message, times or affected items of a maintenance window. Send only the fields to change. API: PATCH /user/api/v1/maintenances/{id}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: statuspageme_list_incidents, statuspageme_create_incident, statuspageme_create_maintenance · Public sink: statuspageme_create_incident, statuspageme_add_incident_update, statuspageme_create_maintenance, statuspageme_update_maintenance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: statuspageme_list_incidents, statuspageme_create_incident, statuspageme_create_maintenance · Public sink: statuspageme_create_incident, statuspageme_add_incident_update, statuspageme_create_maintenance, statuspageme_update_maintenance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
